budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director's salary will increase by 5% in the FY 11 budget.

budget_items.topic: FY 11 Budget - Town departments and School Department funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town departments are level funded, the School Department decreases 1%, and this assures the library meets State Aid requirements without a waiver.
The minimum needed for State Aid is $329, 791, with a 5% decrease in State Aid factored in.
budget_items.quote: $329, 791 is the minimum needed for state aid; kerry factored in a 5% decrease in state aid

budget_items.topic: FY 11 Budget - three budget scenarios discussed
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board discussed three FY 2011 budget levels: Level Service, Minimum State Aid, and 5% less than State Aid requirements; the Minimum State Aid budget was then accepted and submitted.
budget_items.quote: board discussed the fy 2011 budgets at level service request ($335,791), minimum state aid request ($329, 791) and 5% less than state aid requirements ($313,303)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kerry spoke about retirement options for town employees; LPL has two staff at 5% longevity and one at 3.5%.
budget_items.quote: lpl has two staff at 5% longevity, 1 at 3.5%

budget_items.topic: FY 10 Budget - spending of grant and trust funds
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The library continues to spend Revolving Fund, All-Purpose Trust Funds and miscellaneous funds (LSTA grant) on library materials, expected to close by April; no amounts printed.
budget_items.quote: continuing to spend monies from revolving fund, all-purpose trust funds and miscellaneous funds (lsta grant) on library materials

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A former Lunenburg resident left $5,000 to LPL, accepted and placed in the permanent endowment.
